name: thermal_drift_false_touchdown
hypothesis: At 1 N per minute, positive force bias reaches the 0.5 N touchdown threshold after 30 seconds. Filtering cannot remove this sustained bias, so insertion can terminate before the plate reaches support.
expected_failure: Step 6 falsely declares touchdown and releases an unsupported plate. The resulting fall may cause bouncing, excessive lean, or incorrect tine contact and fail the seating check.
real_world_story: The wrist sensor warms after its startup tare while the robot performs the preceding operations.
